insurer: Zurich Kotak General Insurance Company (India) Limited

room_rent.note: Base plan has no room rent cap. Optional add-on 2.B.11 allows downgrade to Single Private AC Room or Shared Room for a premium discount.

icu.note: ICU covered up to Sum Insured opted; proportionate deductions not applied for ICU charges.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan. Zone II insured treating in Zone I bears 10% co-pay. Optional Smart Select (2.B.10) adds 20% co-pay for non-listed hospitals. Voluntary co-pay available as optional add-on (2.B.13).

sub_limits.note: No disease-wise or procedure-wise monetary sub-limits found in the policy wording. All covered benefits payable up to Total Sum Insured.

deductible.note: Optional deductible available under 2.B.12; amount chosen by policyholder and specified in Policy Schedule.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Optional add-on 2.B.8 allows reduction to a shorter period (specific period mentioned in Policy Schedule); available only at first purchase.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Optional add-on 2.B.9 reduces this to 12 months; available only at first purchase. List includes cataract, hernia, joint replacement, BPH, varicose veins, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity hospitalisation excluded under base plan (Excl18). Optional 2.B.5.3 Maternity Benefit provides up to ₹25,000 discount within network and 20% discount on gynaec/diagnostics/pharmacy; not a full indemnity cover. Ectopic pregnancy covered under base plan.

cumulative_bonus.note: Base Cumulative Bonus: 50% per claim-free year, max 100% of Base SI. Optional Cumulative Bonus Booster (2.B.3) adds 100%/yr up to 500% of Base SI additionally.

restoration.note: Inbuilt Unlimited Restoration Benefit (2.A.4): restores Base SI unlimited times per year after full exhaustion of Base SI + Cumulative Bonus + Booster + Double Cover. Usable for related and unrelated illnesses.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days preceding admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 180 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Day Care Treatment covered as per definition (technological advancement enabling <24hr procedures).

domiciliary.note: Covered under 2.A.1.6 for minimum 3 consecutive days. Excludes asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, influenza, arthritis, and several other listed conditions.

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient and day care treatment covered under 2.A.1.5 up to Sum Insured.

organ_donor.note: In-patient hospitalisation expenses for organ harvesting from donor covered under 2.A.1.7. Screening, pre/post-hosp for donor, and organ acquisition costs excluded.

ambulance.display: Up to limit in Policy Schedule
ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to limit specified in Policy Schedule. Air ambulance available as optional add-on (2.B.7).

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered under 2.A.1.3 including robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, stem cell therapy etc. Other modern treatments excluded.

consumables.note: Consumables Cover available as optional add-on (2.B.4) covering non-medical items in Annexure II List 1 for medically necessary hospitalisation.

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment in India only; all claims must have cause of action in India.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim contestable except on grounds of fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for annual/quarterly/half-yearly premium; 15 days for monthly instalment. Coverage not available during grace period.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability.

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: Hormone replacement therapy, RMO/surcharges, external prosthetics, alopecia, mental retardation, non-allopathic (excl. AYUSH), Remicade/Avastin OPD, military ops

optional_riders.display: Double Cover, Consumables, Air Ambulance, Cumulative Bonus Booster, OPD Benefit, Dental Benefit, Maternity Benefit, Get Fit, Wellness, Annual Health Check-up, Smart Select, Deductible, Voluntary Co-pay, Room Category Modification, PED/Specific Disease WP reduction
